summary: RFC 5280 defines extended key purpose identifiers for X.509 certificates. This document defines additional identifiers for the Extended Key Usage extension in certificates used by Network Functions in the 5G System. Their uses include securing JSON objects in HTTP messages with JWTs and signing OAuth 2.0 access tokens.

eli5.summary: Certificates can say what a badge is allowed to do. This adds new badge labels so parts of a 5G network can show which jobs they may do.
